Traffic Diversions in Connection with Construction of the Elevated Corridor from Paradise Junction to Dairy Farm Road (NH-44)

In view of the commencement of construction of the Elevated Corridor from Paradise Junction to Dairy Farm Road on NH-44, the following road closures and traffic diversions will be implemented from 30.10.2025 for a period of approximately nine (09) months.

🛑 Road Closure:

The road stretch between Rajiv Gandhi Statue Junction and Balamrai, in both directions, will remain closed during the construction period.

Commuters are advised to avoid the route between Balamrai and CTO Junction, as traffic congestion is expected on adjoining roads and junctions.

🔁 Diversion Points / Alternate Routes:

From Balanagar towards Panjagutta / Tank Bund:
→ Tadbund → Mastan Café → Diamond Point → Right Turn → Mudfort → NCC → JBS → SBI

From Suchitra towards Panjagutta / Tank Bund:
→ Safe Express → Left Turn → Bapuji Nagar → Centre Point → Diamond Point → Mudfort → NCC → JBS → SBI

From Tank Bund / Rani Gunj / Panjagutta / Rasoolpura / Plaza towards Tadbund:
→ Divert at Rajiv Gandhi Statue Junction → Anna Nagar → Balamrai → Tadbund

For Residents of Anna Nagar:
→ Use internal bylanes (Meeting Point bylane, Hockey Ground bylane, L&O Police Station bylane) to reach destinations without taking the route towards Rajiv Gandhi Statue Junction.
→ Alternatively, proceed via Balamrai.

📱 Public Advisory:
Commuters are requested to follow real-time traffic updates on our social media platforms:

Facebook: https://t.co/RMgFu4rSW3
X (Twitter): @HYDP
For travel assistance or emergencies, please contact our Traffic Helpline: 9010203626.

All citizens are requested to cooperate with the Hyderabad Traffic Police and plan their travel accordingly.

Ensure befitting, meticulous execution of arrangements for "Run for Unity" & Celebration of UT Diwas: Div Com Kashmir to officers
Directs for conduct of dry run of series of programmes
SRINAGAR, OCTOBER 28: Ensure befitting and meticulous execution of entrusted responsibilities for the smooth and successful conduct of "Run for Unity" and celebration of UT Foundation Diwas/ Ekta Diwas directed Divisional Commissioner Kashmir, Anshul Garg to officers while chairing a meeting at SKICC, today.
While taking the final review of preparations with officers, the Div Com issued slew of directions for comprehensive arrangements to ensure no space for loophole or lackadaisical approach.
The Div Com directed for conduct of step-by-step proceedings in a synchronized manner for vibrant celebrations of the day.
He directed departments for the enthusiastic and overwhelming participation in the programmes and instructed participants to arrive at the venue before 8:30 AM.
The Div Com issued detailed directions regarding arrangements, including erection of pandals in the SKICC back lawn, singing of the National Anthem before the flag-off of the “Run for Unity” and at the conclusion of the UT Diwas celebration in the auditorium. He further instructed for stage decoration, distribution of caps, pick-and-drop facilities, VIP and participant seating, parking management, and distribution of refreshment. 
He directed Information Department for finalization of documentary to be screened during the event, installation of video walls and standees and creation of creative backdrop highlighting the theme of unity and progress.
Div com directed Traffic Police to issue advance traffic advisory for effective and meticulous traffic regulation.
He also reviewed compilation of success stories by departments and performance of cultural programmes.
Meanwhile, he took stock of the readiness of a photo exhibition showcasing vibrancy of UT of J&K besides achievements by the departments.
Moreover, he issued directions to civil departments for ensuring comprehensive arrangements for basic amenities including availability of drinking water, uninterrupted electricity, mobile toilet facility, medical staff, ambulances, and fire tenders.
Besides Deputy Commissioner Srinagar & DIG Police, the meeting was attended by HoDs and officers of Health, Education, JKEDI, Information, Horticulture, Agriculture, ICDS, JalShakti, KPDCL, Handloom and Handicraft, Hospitality and Protocol, police, BSF, Sanitation Welfare, RTC, SMC, Floriculture and other concerned departments.
